headline: Record revenue and wider margin drive higher profit
summary_short: U.S. Bancorp's Q3 2026 net revenue was a record $7.97B; net income was $2.20B (+10% y/y) and diluted EPS $1.34 (+9.8% y/y, down from $1.35 in Q2).
summary_long: Net interest income rose 5.6% y/y and fee revenue 14.9%, producing 240 bps of positive operating leverage. Net interest margin was 2.84%, up 5 bps q/q and 9 bps y/y, and the efficiency ratio improved to 55.9%. Average loans grew 8.0% y/y and average deposits 2.9%. Net charge-offs were 0.51% of loans. Return on tangible common equity was 18.5% and the CET1 ratio 10.8%. The quarterly dividend declared was $0.54 per share, up from $0.52.
confidence_notes: The 8-K cover has no EX-99 named exhibit in the folder index; the earnings release document in the same filing was used. Growth rates are as stated in the release highlights; margin and efficiency q/q changes computed from the three-quarter table. CET1 is as of September 30, 2026.

drivers.explanation: Net interest income rose 5.6% y/y; average loans grew 8.0% and the margin widened 9 bps y/y.
Fee revenue grew 14.9% y/y, helping produce record net revenue.
Positive operating leverage of 240 basis points versus the prior-year quarter.
